name: High Value Transaction
description: Flags single transactions that meet or exceed ₹10,00,000 threshold across all payment rails.

name: Rapid Transaction Velocity
description: Flags accounts initiating 10 or more transactions within a sliding 30-minute window.

name: Structuring / Smurfing Detection
description: Detects 3 or more transactions just below the statutory reporting threshold (₹3,50,000 to ₹4,99,999) within 48 hours.

name: Rapid In/Out Movement
description: Flags accounts where funds are credited and 85% or more is immediately transferred out within 15 minutes.

name: High-Risk Geographic Flow
description: Flags transactions originating from or directed to FATF blacklisted or monitored greylist jurisdictions.

name: Sudden Customer Behavior Change
description: Flags transactions exceeding 300% of customer's declared monthly income or 500% of historical average turnover.

name: Round Amount Transactions
description: Flags large, non-commercial round sum transactions (e.g. ₹5,00,000, ₹10,00,000, ₹25,00,000) indicative of illicit settlement.

name: Off-Hours High Value Activity
description: Flags high-value transactions (> ₹3,00,000) initiated during anomalous nocturnal hours (01:00 AM - 04:00 AM).

name: PEP or Sanctions Indicator
description: Flags any transaction where customer or counterparty matches Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) or Sanctions Watchlists.

name: Layering Chain Detection
description: Identifies multi-hop pass-through fund routing (A -> B -> C -> D) with low retention (<15%) within 60 minutes.

name: Multi-Source Fan-In / Fan-Out
description: Detects accounts receiving aggregated funds from 5 or more distinct sources and quickly dispersing them.
